connectorUiConfig.title: SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [SailPoint](https://www.sailpoint.com/) Identity Security Cloud data connector provides the capability to ingest search events into Microsoft Sentinel through the REST API. The connector provides customers the ability to extract audit information from their Identity Security Cloud tenant. Refer to [SailPoint Developer Documentation](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/authentication/) for API authentication details.

sampleQueries.description: Get sample of SailPoint Identity Security Cloud events

sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
 | where Status == 'FAILED'
 | project TimeGenerated, TechnicalName, Operation, EventType
 | order by TimeGenerated desc

{{graphQueriesTableName}}
 | where EventType == 'AUTH' and TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
 | project TimeGenerated, TechnicalName, Status
 | order by TimeGenerated desc

dataTypes.name: {{graphQueriesTableName}}
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
 | where TimeGenerated > ago(12h)
 | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
 | where isnotempty(Time)

customs.name: SailPoint Identity Security Cloud OAuth2 Client Credentials
customs.description: An OAuth2 **Client ID** and **Client Secret** with the `sp:search:read` scope are required. Create a Personal Access Token(PAT) in your SailPoint Tenant. Kindly refer to documentation on our Compass Community for step-by-step instructions.

instructionSteps.title: SailPoint Identity Security Cloud Connections
instructionSteps.description: Add and manage connections to your SailPoint Identity Security Cloud tenant.

parameters.content:
#### 1. Find your Tenant ID and Domain
Your **Tenant ID** is the subdomain of your SailPoint URL.

| Environment | Your URL | Tenant ID | Domain |
|---|---|---|---|
| Production | `https://acme.identitynow.com` | `acme` | `identitynow.com` |
| Demo/Partner | `https://ta-partner19947.identitynow-demo.com` | `ta-partner19947` | `identitynow-demo.com` |

The connector will call: `https://{Tenant ID}.api.{Domain}/v2025/search/events`

#### 2. Create a Personal Access Token(PAT).
1. Log in to your Identity Security Cloud tenant. Click your profile name in the top-right corner and select Preferences from the dropdown menu.
2. On the left-hand navigation pane, select **Personal Access Tokens**.
3. Click the **New Token** button.
4. In the **What is this token for?** field, enter a clear and meaningful description of how this token will be used.
5. Select an expiration date.
6. From the **Vendor Integration** dropdown menu, select **Microsoft Azure Sentinel for SailPoint IdentityNow**.
7. Select `sp:search:read` scope to query the Search API.
8. Click Create Token. Immediately copy and securely save both the Client ID and the Secret.**Important:** The Secret is displayed only once and cannot be retrieved again after you close the window.
